correctness.rationale: The proof classifies all possible initial cardinalities. For noncomplete complete multipartite graphs the ordinary zero forcing number is exactly \(N-2\). Every size-\(N-2\) candidate leaves vertices in two distinct parts, so the first-round weights and the only possible second-round continuation are explicit; this yields \(T_\alpha(G)\). Size \(N-1\) succeeds exactly up to the maximum-degree threshold \(\Delta\alpha\). Exact rational exhaustive simulation on all multipartite types through order 8 found no mismatch and checks the source subfamilies. The computation is a stress test, not the infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The paper's maximum-degree theorem decides only the top phase \(Z_{\alpha,\beta}(G)=N\). It does not distinguish the \(N-2\) and \(N-1\) regimes. The new functional \(T_\alpha(G)\) resolves that missing regime for all complete multipartite graphs, so the broader general theorem does not dominate the claim.

originality.rationale: The initiating paper was inspected at the same invariant and closest exact graph families. It gives complete-graph, star, and complete-bipartite formulas but no arbitrary complete-multipartite theorem; targeted semantic-index and web searches under multipartite, tripartite, Turan, and formula aliases found no statement that implies the new threshold functional. The result strictly extends the published two-part formulas while reproducing them algebraically. Residual risk from unindexed or later material is recorded.
residual_risks: Transmission zero forcing is a recent invariant, so unindexed manuscripts or later updates could exist. The checked searches did not locate such a source, but failed search is not treated as proof of global novelty.

value.rationale: The result gives a natural complete classification for a classical broad graph family at a newly introduced forcing invariant. It unifies all complete and complete-bipartite formulas in the initiating paper, resolves the previously uncomputed intermediate regime for arbitrary part structures, and provides a direct threshold functional useful for Turan and other multipartite specializations. This is structural rather than a routine parameter substitution.
